scoring_justification: The checker verifies structural relations (signs, ordering) and paper-reported thresholds; recomputing the full DFT+MLFF phonon spectrum is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: low‑energy chirality threshold |s|≥1/4; antisymmetry s_q = -s_{-q} exact; response tensor signs and relative magnitudes stated in Section V.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's reported values and physical claims
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own quantitative thresholds and structural assertions, suitable for result‑level comparison.

outputs.description: Low-energy chirality statistics: maximum |s|, count of modes with |s|≥0.25, and total modes <25 meV.
Antisymmetry check for Γ‑X: maximum deviation and consistency flag.
Intrinsic response tensor components at 300 K, without relaxation time τ.

output_contract.notes: All values are the agent's computed results; the checker will evaluate consistency with paper relations, not absolute exact numbers.

rubric.description: max_s >= 0.25 earns 0.5; count_s_above_quarter > 0 earns 0.3; total_low_energy_modes > 0 earns 0.2
Score based on structural relations: alpha_xx >0 (+0.2), alpha_yy <0 (+0.2), alpha_zz <0 (+0.2), |alpha_xx| > |alpha_yy| (+0.2), |alpha_xx| > |alpha_zz| (+0.2). Total capped at 1.0.
